In 2026, an industrial group with plants in Europe, North Africa, and Southeast Asia wants to finance decarbonization retrofits through green bonds. Taxonomy definitions, disclosure standards, and investor ESG expectations differ across the EU, Gulf, and Asian capital markets, and internal plants report emissions with inconsistent measurement quality. Rating agencies and regional banks give conflicting guidance.

Propose a financing strategy that structures green-bond issuance across markets with divergent taxonomies and disclosure standards, while managing measurement-quality risk and protecting the group's credibility with investors.
